items.title: Nick Brignola interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, July 28, 1997
items.q: But I mean I got to hang with Lockjaw Davis

ctx.x: Marshall Royal. And then Marshall says — I said to him, “You’re only a dumb saxophone player, and you showed me those clarinet fingers.” He started to laugh, he says, “Yeah, but people don’t know that I was a clarinet player — I was a clarinet major.” That was his axe. His fingerings, to this day, work for me. All the other fingerings are like, “Try this, maybe this will work, try that.” Marshall was right on the money. But I mean I got to hang with Lockjaw Davis — when would I have been able to — So these…
I think it’s kind of social show.
